protocol:
1. Arrange labeled chilled PCR tubes in a green ice bucket on the bench and prepare an adjustable single-channel micropipette, disposable tips in a blue rack, and tube racks.

2. Transfer an aliquot of clear liquid from a small tube/well in the blue rack into a labeled chilled PCR tube using the micropipette.

3. Repeat the clear-liquid transfer into additional labeled chilled PCR tubes, returning the tubes to ice between additions.

4. Cap the prepared PCR tubes securely by hand.

5. Open the heated lid of a Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler and place the capped PCR tubes into the block/green insert.

6. Close the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler lid.

7. Use the T100 touchscreen to select and start the saved thermal-cycling program with the reaction volume set to 25 µL; the run screen displays a temperature profile and approximately 58 min remaining.
